summary.zh: 在动手做 PPT 前定好叙事、来源和设计方向
summary.en: Plan deck narrative, sources, and design direction first

description.zh: 在生成幻灯片之前先确认受众、结论、页数、语言和品牌要求，选定叙事框架并登记每条数据与观点的来源。适合新建可编辑 PPT 的起步阶段，避免做到一半返工。
description.en: Locks audience, message, slide count, language, and sources before any slide is authored, then records the narrative framework and design direction. Use it at the start of a new editable deck.
